About Me

Crafting code,
driving insights.

I am a B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student at Lovely Professional University, Punjab, with a strong academic record of 8.1 CGPA and a deep-rooted interest in building technology that solves real-world problems.

My technical expertise spans the full development spectrum — from systems-level programming in C++, Rust, and Java to data-driven applications using Python, TensorFlow, and Scikit-Learn, and modern web development with React and Flask. I have hands-on experience delivering complete projects across data analytics, machine learning, and software engineering domains.

Beyond academics, I am a Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA), a first-prize winner at CodeFest powered by Infosys, and hold a 5-star ranking in both Python and C++ on HackerRank — demonstrating consistent performance in competitive and professional environments alike.
